name: @skathi-native/cli
description: The sk CLI: SFC compiler, dev and production builders, packaging and devtools for Skathi apps.

comments.@vitejs/plugin-vue: Bundled at prepack for the default Vue compiler. An installed CLI must not pull the Vue peer into Svelte applications.
comments.tailwindcss: Optional peer, 3.x only: v3 emits literal declarations that crates/sk-css maps onto gpui; v4 uses var(--tw-*) + calc() + @property, which the engine does not fully resolve yet (see tailwind.ts). Loaded from the app, only when it has a tailwind.config.*.
comments.@modelcontextprotocol/sdk: devDependency: used only by devtools/mcp.ts. devtools/ctl.ts is dependency-free so an agent can drive the app through Bash without bun install.
comments.typescript: sk check and the AOT input inventory (sk build --aot-inputs). Builds do not invoke tsc: bun transpiles .ts directly.
comments.svelte: devDependency: types and tests. A Svelte app compiles with its own svelte/compiler, the version its runtime is.
comments.vue: devDependency: types and tests. A Vue app compiles its .vue files with its own vue/compiler-sfc, the version its runtime is.
